name: smwmusic-fanfare-in-g-minor
title: Fanfare in G# Minor
description:
A short fanfare in G# minor.
Intended as a replacement for either the "boss clear" or "stage clear" theme.
The text file has a 3 options (echo, end chord, goal tape sound at start) that can be set to 0 or 1.
The listed insert size and length on this submission are the size and length that result from setting all options to 1.

EDIT 4/10/21: Fixed Goal Tape sound to be proper tempo.
